Patch release focused on Mole installer scan compatibility.

- Fixed installer-package scanning after Mole is installed through the StowMind onboarding guide.
- Added support for Mole script discovery in manual installs under `~/.config/mole`.
- Kept Homebrew Mole layouts supported through `/opt/homebrew` and `/usr/local` libexec paths.

Note: macOS artifacts may be ad-hoc signed unless Apple signing secrets are configured.
